description:
When Suh volunteered as a beta tester for a cutting-edge ultra VR game, he never imagined he'd be stuck there for the next 20 years. It was only after he finally died in the game he managed to "log off" from the game… only to realize five years have passed in real-life. Reality seemed a lot harsher than the game world he had left, as his family went broke having to pay his hospital bills all those years he lay in bed in a coma while stuck in the game. Pressed by loansharks, Suh decides to turn to what he does best... and logs back into the game, hoping to make enough money in the gaming world to convert it into real life currency and pay off the debt. To his pleasant surprise, Suh discovers that he gets to keep most of what he learned over 20 years of being stuck in the previous version of the game! This should be pretty easy... right?

(Source: Pocket Comics)
